label: Prepositions
outcome: Lo studente sceglie preposizioni scolastiche ad alta frequenza per tempo, luogo e movimento e riconosce alcune combinazioni lessicali essenziali senza tradurre parola per parola dall'italiano.
must_master: at/in/on and basic position prepositions for place
movement such as to/into/out of/across/through at programme level
common adjective/verb + preposition combinations at programme level
distinguish position from movement when context requires it
do_not_teach_yet: phrasal verbs as a separate syllabus

italian_learner_risks.risk: using a position preposition when movement is meant
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: She walked in the room when the intended meaning is entering it.

italian_learner_risks.risk: translating common combinations word for word

quality_rejections: a random list of dozens of prepositions
testing phrasal verbs as if they were spatial prepositions
